regions.label: INESHeader
regions.evidence: iNES header parsed by rom.info: magic, PRG/CHR sizes and CNROM mapper fields.

regions.label: CHRBankValues
regions.evidence: Four-byte 00 01 02 03 bank-value lookup at CPU $8000; startup begins at validated reset vector $8004.

Two adjacent indexed byte arrays at CPU $8D13/$8D1D between BMI $8D33 and health clamp routine $8D27. First traversal falsely falls through the always-taken BMI after DEC underflow; explicit data barrier. Role beyond byte lookup unresolved.

regions.label: HardwareVectors
regions.evidence: Hardware little-endian NMI/reset/IRQ vectors $8057,$8004,$80F2 at CPU $FFFA..FFFF.

regions.label: CHRPatternBanks
regions.evidence: iNES CHR-ROM size/offset defines four 8 KiB CNROM pattern banks. PPU tile backing, not CPU instruction storage.
Uniform FF suffix up to hardware vectors. Inspected preceding bytes and static entry paths; no code fetch or control target in suffix. Generic non-code, no original fill-purpose claim.

16 little-endian target words consumed by $D022 stack-return dispatcher: A nibble range 0..15, ASL and Y+1 index into return-address bytes. Inline bytes are not a JSR fallthrough. Targets remain separate code claims.
